negotiation.batch: one Token-Tier header per response array, carrying the minimum tier applied across its elements; v1 defines no per-element signal, so a client reads each element's tier from its shape

tiers.2: full: ABI decode (function/event + named args) + log collapse + logsBloom drop + hex to decimal

tierSources._: A tier number alone does not say WHO applied it. Every response from this server states `_meta.tier_source` beside `_meta.tier`.
tierSources.proxy: The tiers above, applied by the Ankr RPC proxy on the JSON-RPC path: ABI decode, log collapse, hex to decimal.
tierSources.local: Applied in the MCP server itself, on the Sui gRPC path, where no proxy is involved. 0 = the view's read_mask projection; 1 = lossless (ancestor echoes and empty containers dropped, repeated envelopes unwrapped, byte vectors rendered as text); 2 = 1 plus BCS blobs dropped, owners collapsed, repeated columns hoisted, collections grouped or keyed. There is no ABI decoding on this path, but there IS an `args` field: getLogs, suiWatchEvents and the pages expandResult continues carry each Move event's own struct, decoded by the node rather than from an ABI, under `args` — at every tier, tier 0 included. So `args` proves tier 2 only where tier_source is `proxy`; here `_meta.tier` is the only thing that does.
